notes: Auto Loot now picks up nearly twice as much while you move. It was paying a small wait meant for spell casts on every single tap, and you hold movement keys the whole time you grind, so a 0.3 second pickup key was really running at 0.55. Only real casts wait now. Also: a character added to your profiles folder shows up without restarting the app, and the EXP troubleshooter now tells you when a game window is simply covering the bar instead of blaming your HUD.
